exposure: World Health Organization functional class (WHO-FC) III/IV
cohort: 181 pregnant patients with pulmonary arterial hypertension (PAH) undergoing cesarean delivery, including 85 without cardiac shunt and 96 with shunt.
finding: General anesthesia and WHO-FC III/IV were predictors for worse peripartum outcomes (MACEs and maternal death) in PAH gravidae without cardiac shunt, whereas only WHO-FC III/IV was a predictor for those with shunt.
mod_finding: General anesthesia administered during C-section was found to increase the risk of MACEs and maternal mortality in PAH patients without a cardiac shunt, but not in those with a shunt.
